items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Oh, yeah, they had one from Laplace. What was his name? His name was Joe Robinet.

ctx.x: Yes, of course, I learned a whole lot is when I come to the city.
Yes, well, when you were young, did you watch any of the old bass players?
Oh, yeah, they had one from Laplace. What was his name? His name was Joe Robinet. Joe Robinet. He got drunk.
